full_prompt_en: A square science-fiction concept painting shows a lone worker in orange standing on an immense gray landing ground beneath pale industrial towers. The worker occupies the lower-left center with their back to the viewer, a small dark head above the bright suit and black boots planted on the wet surface. Across the middle distance, a bulky orange-and-gray craft sits at far left, while a smaller angular vehicle rests to the right. Several tiny figures walk near them, giving scale to the vast site. Tall gray tower forms rise behind the vehicles, their upper structures dense with antennas, rails and small protrusions. Thin cables hang and stretch across the upper half, crossing a nearly white overcast sky. Small dark flying marks and a pale circular disc are scattered in the distance. The foreground is a broad plane of slate gray with orange paint-like reflections and long horizontal seams. It has subtle puddled shine but remains rough with sketchy scuffs and dark scratches. The large towers are only partly resolved, fading into white atmospheric haze as they recede. Flat cold light comes through the fog, leaving faint shadows; the orange suit and machinery become the strongest color accents rather than sunlit highlights. Quick dark linework and broad opaque brush strokes define the technology without precise mechanical exposition. No readable text appears. The overall composition is expansive and austere, using tiny warm figures and machines to measure a monumental pale-gray world.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形科幻概念绘画呈现一名橘衣工人站在辽阔灰色停机坪上，头顶是浅色工业巨塔。工人位于下方偏左中央，背对观者，亮橘服装上方是小小暗色头部，黑靴踩在湿润表面。中景横向展开：最左停着一架厚重橘灰飞行器，右边还有一架较小的角状载具。几名极小人物在它们附近行走，给庞大场地提供尺度。高灰色塔形升在载具后，其上部密布天线、栏杆与小突起。细缆线悬挂并横过上半部，穿行于近白的阴天。远处散落小深色飞行痕迹与一个浅色圆盘。前景是宽阔板岩灰平面，带橘色颜料般反光与长水平接缝。它有浅淡积水光泽，也保留粗糙速写擦痕和暗划线。大塔只部分解决，向后退时淡入白色空气雾。平坦冷光从雾中穿过，留下微弱阴影；橘色制服与机器成为最强色彩重音，而非阳光高光。快速深色线描与宽阔不透明笔触描出科技结构，却不解释精密机械。没有可读文字。整体构图开阔而严峻，以微小暖色人物与机器丈量纪念性浅灰世界。
style_prompt_en: A cinematic science-fiction concept-art treatment builds immense scale from broad desaturated gray planes, misty vertical masses and tiny saturated orange accents. Sketchlike black lines describe cables, seams and distant detail, while dry scuffs and broad brush strokes keep the surface visibly painted. Atmospheric haze washes far structures toward white; nearer ground retains dark marks and low wet reflections. Flat cool light suppresses hard shadows, making the warm color function as a sharp navigational signal. Long horizontals stabilize tall dense forms, and very small scale markers heighten the surrounding volume. The image feels austere, industrial and expansive without requiring fully resolved machinery.
style_prompt_zh: 电影感科幻概念美术处理用宽阔降饱和灰色平面、雾中的竖向体量和极小饱和橘色重音建立巨大尺度。速写般黑线描出缆线、接缝与远景细节，干擦痕和宽阔笔触让表面明显保留绘画感。空气雾把远处结构洗向白色；近处地面则有深色痕迹和低矮湿润反光。平坦冷光压低硬阴影，使暖色像鲜明的视线导航信号。长横线稳定高而密的形体，极小尺度参照放大周围体积。画面严峻、工业感强且开阔，无需把机械完全精密化。
theme_en: An orange-clad worker on a vast futuristic landing ground beneath pale industrial towers
theme_zh: 浅色工业巨塔下，一名穿橘色服装的工人站在辽阔未来停机坪

reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
